text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted Vodka secretly jotting down notes.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I get how you feel. But the real danger lies in overthinking things and making the wrong call.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I'll be sure to consult you properly from now on!
And... thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's dark and hard to see......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, I spotted Vodka taking notes again, this time in front of Agnes Tachyon's lab.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, a failure, is it...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
In other words, you could say our chances of success just went up!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you agree?
You there... peering in at us."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no, um... that's not it!
This is, well—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No need to explain... You've come to collaborate with me and increase our probability of success, have you not?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Collaborator?!
I-I had no such intention!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Trainer...?
Training...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Yeah, exactly, that's right!
So, if you'll excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
You really saved me back there...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No, actually, just the other day—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it at all. When people talk about cool,
they mean someone like Brian-senpai or Gim-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Solitary, cool, strutting around like she owns the place?
That vibe is just irresistible, ain't it?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You really are so simple-minded...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about being cool, Air Groove-senpai
and Tachyon-san are plenty cool too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...And that's kind of how we ended up
in an argument, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I've never really looked at either senior in terms of whether they're 'cool' or not.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I was taking another good look at it.
You can't dismiss something without knowing anything about it, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought how dutiful she was,
it seemed she wasn't the only one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Brian-san has a side like that too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "I-It's not like I'm interested in what you call 'cool', but I might as well check it out, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...So, how were Air Groove-senpai and Tachyon-san?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even I don't really get what you mean
by 'coolness,' but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Still, you've been super caring,
and you never gave up even when things went wrong...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I knew Scarlett would
call it cool.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I thought the same thing
watching Brian and Gimlet."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd say
those two seniors are so cool.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In other words—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It just means all our seniors are super cool!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Way to oversimplify things.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Way to oversimplify things.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I mean, that's true if you sum it up like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What about it?
Doesn't change the fact that it's cool, does it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There is! My respect for my senior isn't something
that can be summed up in just a single word!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What's wrong with calling a cool upperclassman cool?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Will you cut it out and stop making a ruckus in front of the student council room already?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry...! I'm truly sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Always bickering, you two.
Go inside and eat something sweet to calm down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Just shut up and eat.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two were left perplexed
by the unusually gentle treatment they received.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer's already plenty cool, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She gives crisp instructions and she's super smart!!
Seeing her try her best is just so damn cool!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How can you just rattle off such cheesy lines
with a straight face...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sweet...? ...Aah?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "T-T-T-That's not what I meant at all!! What the heck are you saying out of nowhere!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, the two of them started bickering all over again. It was great to see they were as close as ever. And they lived happily ever after♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Nothing about this is worth celebrating!!
